critiques.action: Use an authored exposure adjustment while keeping geometry, materials, camera, rig and sampling fixed.
critiques.comparison: Compare the same requested -1.5 EV scene before and after the runtime honors exposure; inspect pale-green tone, cut edges and fold modeling.
critiques.evidence: The sampled right-upright region has 77.8% of opaque pixels with every RGB channel at least 250.

observations: The continuous card has broad rounded upright scores and a forward lower fold. Pale cut stock edges are visible. The right upright is nearly white, losing its supplied pale-green color and much surface modeling. The color-sampling diagnostic records clipping; this is not yet a craft-qualified result. This controlled baseline requested -1.5 EV, but the current scene loader omits it and the compiled quality has no exposure field. Its pixels still show the pale-green region as near-white.
user_feedback: Open paper structures are allowed, without an enclosing border or backing plate. No artistic approval supplied.
